review_text: Not for tablets anymore?!! I've been using this app for years on my tablets, and it started glitching and locking up frequently, so I thought I'll uninstall it and reinstall it. I can't reinstall it. Google play says it's not compatible with tablets now and offers no other app in its place. why??! Now I'm stuck with the online website shopping experience, which is terrible! Customer service was a dead end. This will deter me from shopping on Amazon and may force me to cancel prime.

Can't access our orders for tracking anymore since the recent change. I do a search for my orders and it shows me shipping suggestions. I used to use the app primarily for keeping track of my orders because the web site makes it difficult to tell what's arriving on a particular day and the app used to sort them by the day expected. This was easy, user friendly, and wonderful. Now it's gone. I have no reason to use the app anymore. I can't easily track any packages anymore.

Terrible search algorithm: The app is almost unusable. I have tried and tried to use this site but as the years pass, the search becomes less and less capable. Even 15 years ago I could still use the filters as such. When I searched for an item today, the display photos were massive. Only one item is shown on the screen now. Not only can I not find the correct items, the wrong items take up the whole screen. My eyesight has not changed, nor has my ability to spell or know what I want to buy.

The Amazon app can be frustrating, especially during Prime Day and Black Friday, where pricing feels deceptive. Items are often marked up before being “discounted” making it seem like you’re getting a deal when you’re not. Cancelling Prime if you don't want it anymore is a hassle and customer support can be hit or miss. If you have an issue with an order sometimes you get the runaround or are told you’ve been refunded, only to find out you haven't forcing you to go through the process again.

Amazon has refused to address problems I first brought up years ago, and now they seem to WANT to be impossible to use. Between facing a disabled "continue" button at the payment options screen when paying with gift cards, not being able to buy Amazon gift cards anymore, having Visa cards repeatedly declined without explanation, and useless customer service, I've had my last straw. They've lost me as a customer and I'm deleting my account. This slow, janky app with no offline isn't any better.

This new update is a disaster. Nothing in my wishlist is in order, and there's no way to filter it for most recent items. Search brings up items totally unrelated to the keywords. Not to mention that nearly all orders that have been transferred to USPS disappear and get lost. I live a few miles from a distribution center. There's no reason to transfer them to the post office. Been a member for over 10 years. Disappointed with how things have turned out these last few years.

You have to click through like 5 different pages before you have the option to even speak to customer service. Nothing qualifies for return/replacement or refund. What's worse, Amazon moderates all the reviews, so you can't even warn others about anything. UPDATE: they've incorporated that stupid AI assistant bs, which will pop up with "suggested questions" every time you click on an item. And 80% of the time, it refuses to go away, making a part of your screen unusable. Utterly infuriating.

Until today, I have never had any problems with the app. However, today I can't choose options on an item. For example I select an item that can come in different colors. I checked for updates, and I updated. I cleared cache. I force stopped the app. Nothing has corrected the issue. If it corrects itself, I will edit this review.

Amazon offers a generally excellent customer experience, and I appreciate the convenience and range of products available. However, I have ongoing concerns regarding order fulfillment at the facility level. It seems that every few orders, there is an issue that requires me to contact customer service due to incorrect processing, delays, or errors in shipment. This not only creates inconvenience but also undermines the reliability I expect as a Prime member.

This is especially painful when shopping for niche items, where the sponsored ad doesn't match what I am looking for. I get Amazon is trying to squeeze profits from both ends. But it has gotten to the point where you can't even use the app to shop anymore. Unless you want one of the 3 sponsored brands.

Would be nice if what they showed available in advertising was what they actually had available. The other issue I have is that about 1/4 of the time I order something, the item never shows up. Luckily, they have a great refund policy. So I've never not gotten my money back. 👍

The app itself is great if somewhat confusing, (Seems to be on purpose. A lot of the time one orders the wrong product, which is not the case on Amazon, eBay, or Walmart.) What grates is the amount of mail one gets peppered with. This little $2 purchase, for example, engendered at least five emails plus the almost obligation of writing this review. It almost doesn't seem worthwhile using this app. Sorry.

It's decent, but difficult to find items that have free shipping when filtered instead of items that only SAY free shipping. Shipments to the US take about one month. Many things are below $10, which is amazing, if some of those items didn't also have $10 shipping fee. Also, recently the app has been OPENING ITSELF RANDOMLY while I'm using other apps on my phone. HUGE problem. This only adds to the questionable reliability of this slow-working app. It works, but for how long can I stand it?

I've got to be honest here, I love your site with one big exception.. the shipping is ridiculous..every item has a shipping and that gets expensive. I use another site. Free shipping and you have to spend 10 to order but I get a heck of alot more items then when I do decide to order from here. I can get triple the amount of items on the other app then this one. Just a thing to think about. Maybe one flat shipping price instead of shipping on every single item...

Some items got lost in transit, fortunately not expensive items, not a single seller have offered to send another item. One of the things that bother me is that some sellers state that I confirm receiving a product when I did not. There are other issues,but, I am pretty sure that other consumers had written about them. If you read e-mail between buyers and sellers ,you'll get the picture.

The prices are right, but the advertising practices of a lot of their "stores" I'd deceitful. Read the description very carefully and keep a screen shot of the advertisement for the product you buy. I personally buy a lot of things from the app and although the wait is 60+ days on a lot of items there are very fast deliveries on some things, were not talking Amazon prime delivery speed but fast enough.

Decent prices , shipping generally takes what seems like forever, ranges from 30 -45+ days . Which the tracking setup does not update at all after 4 days so its pretty useless. Most items have free shipping. Do your research and read reviews before purchasing any item, their customer service is non existant , and most times if you cancel an order you only get about 70% of your original purchase money back after 7 to 10 days. Ive been waiting for a shirt and 2 items for well over a month now.

I've been using the app for a few years and haven't had too many scam purchases. Don't just depend on ratings actually read the reviews. 3% negative reviews isn't a lot for a high volume seller, but if every one of them says they were scammed you should pay attention. Thumbnails show more expensive options available than the price listed. Ie: It shows a 50pc set, but the price is for the 5 PC set so pay attention to what you're buying. I do wish the search was better, but it's not horrible.

I like the prices on this app. They have some cool products and they have low prices. It's the wait that kills me. Ordered 1 from the app it took 60 days to get it. I honestly forgot I had ordered till it showed up in my mail. It was a happy surprise but arrived too late for what I needed the item for. But if you plan ahead or don't need your product in a short time frame their prices are awsome!

I've ordered many items and love them. 1 lost in shipping. Customer service was great to reship although I have not received any info about it nor have I received the item. Now my entire history has been wiped from the app. Unless I receive it in the near future I think I may have been had. I am hesitant to rate the app but willing to give a 3 star review.

My previous experiences with AliExpress left me with a bitter taste in my mouth. I started ordering from them again but I would like to remind you not to buy items over $50 because if it isn't as described - it is your problem as their make it right policy does that - for the seller. I however did order some excellent items but did not spend more than $15.00 on any one item. Just saying, be careful because they will not really help fix big problems.

If you want to cancel an order this app only allows it if the seller agrees. The seller can choose to ignore request and not respond at all! I haven't found a way to communicate with aliExpress directly concerning the cancel issue or any issue. You have to wait until a huge amount of time goes by to open a dispute. Sellers ship SLOW. My first order delivery has passed the already very long expected arrival date. So am I thrilled with this? Nope. 3 stars is actually extremely generous.

I'm not a fan of being forced to use an app and sacrificing storage space. If you want to shop here you have to get the app in self-defense against the constant nagging to try it and the inability to access your account otherwise. That's not unique to this app, but shopping for trinkets is supposed to be fun and the aggressive marketing tactics detract and distract. I find good stuff here, but it's much harder to find bulk lots or meaningful quantity price breaks, it feels like eBay now.

Most of the time everything is just as described, shipping may take a couple of weeks for most products but that's fine considering everything is usually pretty cheap. I only really have an issue when I order an item and I'm immediately unable to track it or file a complaint. It always happens at random too! Some items just randomly take my money?!

out of the 15 items iv ordered 3 havent shown up, 3 items were way to small even after carefully looking at measurements, 3 items were totally different then what was listed. The items I am happy with arent enough for me to keep this app. I dont want to have to wonder if I'm ever going to get my products. refunding takes a long time, weeks before they even get back to you about opening a dispute.

Opening a dispute is impossible. I've had a package missing one of three items, had to claim I received it before a dispute can be made. Upon filling out dispute, the submit button is always greyed out, so nothing ever gets sent. Also, I've noticed that you can't leave a review unless you have a picture with a description. You can't just explain your thoughts on the item. Over kill if you ask me.

Good prices. Temu is better for small items but temu doesn't have large items like furniture and stuff. 3 stars because it takes MONTHS to get here. I ordered some stuff and found out later it's not going to arrive for 3 MONTHS. But if it's something you can wait on then the prices are really good. I just didn't think it was going to take months to send literally just 100 tiny cellophan bags for jewelry, lol. I would give it 4 stars if it would let you cancel your items before shipping.

I like it more or less but there's a couple things that are just so frustrating! Firstly, you can't delete all or read all messages, you have to go through one by one and the bubble won't go away until you do so. Secondly, there's a max amount of wish lists which is like...ten? The more wishlist people can have the more likely they'll find that thing they wanted to buy and the more likely it'll be bought so I don't understand the limit.

It's alright for the most part. My account was connected to my Google account, it let me use Gpay to pay. The only problem with that is that most of the time the app won't allow me to pay & always claims that "payment was unsuccessful due to security reasons". I was getting fed up not being able to order any more items because of this issue. So instead I went ahead and deleted my account. I really want to make a new account & see what happens this time around but I don't know...

While I like the site for finding a wide variety of products, I have some issues. 1) It can be difficult to find what you search for because other products appear besides your specific request. 2) It is impossible to find the items you purchased in the past, so it's easy to order the same ones unintentionally. There should be a selection for purchase history. Another drawback is that the teasers for money off or free items are basically bogus because they require you to spend a lot of money.

My experience with Aliexpress has not been good. So I will not be using them anymore. I ordered 3 times and 2 of the orders were late. Also, i played their Prizeland. Got the $7 free shopping credit. Tried to use the credit and it wouldn't let me use it and on the 3rd try i lost the credit. I stopped playing. Another thing is that everytime i tried to use the search bar, it didn't show me anything that i wanted to see. They need to improve their site. They lost me as a customer.

It's not a bad app. The reason for the less stars is that the navigation and multiple carts and so many of the same products just different sources and different prices. It would be better to have 1 shopping cart and not several based on gimmick discounts. It would also be nice if the same product would be grouped together so you can choose the best price. Pictures and descriptions are identical and redundant to see the same thing over and over when there are so many things that could be seen.

I've enjoyed buying from the vendors on this app. Everything I've purchased has been great. However, it gets glitchy when I play the in-app game "Money Hop" more than twice in a row and it's irritating because I really enjoy that little game. I'm also perplexed by the "coins" system - I've yet to save more than a couple of pennies here and there. I will continue to shop with AliExpress, but I hope the glitchiness gets remedied and my "coins" will begin giving more sizable discounts.

I love the app itself, it is harder to contact customer service than Ebay. my problem is with the sellers I had 25 orders canceled and refunded because I didn't pay, if I didn't pay why are you issuing me a refund that is over 45 days. the chat option sucks cause it's not a real person so you get automatic responses that don't help at all. I've been waiting for items that will never come. I will still shop this app for the great prices but with lowered expectations.

I'm generally happy with my purchases through the app. The one complaint is I ordered two items on the same order and only received 1 item so far. 1 us dollar is not fair compensation for a continuing to wait for a product that was not even shipped for 14 days after the order was placed and paid for. It is unacceptable and will be considered for all future purchases.

Never any tracking information, so basically you just wait..maybe you'll get your items. Maybe you won't??. Its difficult to figure out when to open a dispute...I mean you want the stuff,,but it would be nice if the tracking information updated. But it never does.. Totally a gamble..a couple stores are reliable but I fear some are just a scam.

The app is confusing to use, possibly because of all the translated chinese. Discount coupons sometimes work sometimes don't. The search function is pretty wonky for English speakers. Generally you have to try several different Search terms to find what you are looking for. Unfortunately, there is no way to organize listings. The same item might be sold by 30 different vendors with wildly different prices. The savings do makeup for it though

With current update, descriptions don't show. Items often show fake prices to get me to click. Items are misrepresented including wrong sizes, then only a partial refund is offered, and the description is not corrected. On the other hand, there are many items that are a great value. These problems are really related to the business model rather than the app, but they are inseparable.

Shipping takes awhile to the US but if you can wait then the app is good. I had 1 bad experience during covid, they shipped my items and it took so long to get here that by the time it arrived I had already moved houses. My packages were lost and no refund was given and no accountability for my packages arriving months later than stated. If you are willing to spend an amount that you don't mind losing if your package gets lost then you probably won't be disappointed too much. Also read reviews

This update is a step backwards, because the new search filters are less specific, and sometimes not applicable to the search category. Before, I could search for clothes in a range of colors, sizes, styles, etc. Searching for a tablet in the latest version, I can't search for a more than one screen size, one operating system version at a time, though the search results include many tablets not the right size, system, etc. And the price range is meaningless since vendors post misleading prices.

It's a really great service! I've gotten decent quality items in the past + it's easy to use! However my issue is the shipping/shipping times. A lot of times I check the shipping on the items I order and it says it's in my city, yet the next day I check it says it hasn't even been sorted in the sorting centers! Aliexpress would be top tier if they fixed this small issue, because quite frankly I'm tired of checking the mail every single morning, just to be disappointed.

Love the deals and ability to buy the same items sold in the states for a half of a price but returns/refunds are pain and almost non existent. Also customer service is terrible, they tend to take side of the seller even when he is in the wrong, like for example sent you a complete wrong item. Sizing for clothes is also an issue, most of the. items are in Asian size so my Amercian US 6 is like XL there and varies from seller to a seller, always ask before you purchase anything.

I've been a customer for 5 years or more. Made videos about hauls. Products were hit or miss. I heard they changed owners. I go into the app today and it's completely different. Like most of the features gone. Search not showing any results. Very shocked. I deleted the application. I spent hundreds of dollars with them but I guess it doesn't matter anymore because yuan is better. You can't depend on usd anymore.

Shopping AliExpress is a far cry from shopping on Amazon, but I enjoy having access to China direct products. There are a whole bunch of little quirks to workout with the app. For instance, I just left feedback on a purchase and the controls for text editing were garbage. It took way longer than it should have, because just navigating around the text and making changes was tedious. That said, it gets the job done.

The only thing I dislike about this app/AliExpress is that it shows the lowest price for the item when browsing. Then, when you click in to buy the item, it shows a price range and the cost is inevitably always a higher price which is often $3 to $10+ more than what you see browsing for the product. I wish they would show the price range before I click on the product. That's just tricky advertising that I don't really care for.

Some good deals, but some poor quality. I bought some sonoff switches which were decent for the price. But when I bought a pair of TWS earbuds which did not wirelessly charge properly as advertised, and had a difference in volume between each earbud I reached out to support to return my item. Even after taking pictures and sending a video to support my problem, they said it wasn't a valid reason for return. That was about a year ago, and due to that experience, I won't use it anymore.

I've bought some cool stuff off here. Beware because some of the sellers are VERY rude and lack communication. Be prepared to wait a long time to receive items. The best items to go for are ones with picture reviews. Stuff is cheap and you can find almost everything. I've been having an issue where stuff keeps disappearing from my cart which is really fishy. 😬

Lost orders. Really long shipping times if item shipped from overseas. Watch for shipping costs, they add up so what seemed like a good deal won't always be a good deal. With that said, there are good deals to be had. You have to be vigilant & always read the descriptions. Some items can arrive quickly even from overseas. Which leaves you kind of scratching your head. But you can find things here that you probably won't find anywhere else. I'd give app better rating if it was more consistent.

An interesting place to shop. Just be prepared, sometimes packages arrive damaged due to extremely aggressive application of tape and bubble wrap. Sometimes things just never arrive at all. Sometimes tracking info is wrong or entirely unavailable. This has all happened to me several times now when buying trading cards, computer parts, and handheld games consoles. I got a refund for almost all the missing and damaged items, but a couple were never resolved.

So we've all seen the jokes about ordering things online that are advertised to look one way and you get them and they don't look like the picture. 20% out of 100 have dealt with this on this site and That is pretty low and so far I just bought a few pieces from this site and every one of them are great quality and it actually shipped faster than I expected my advice if it doesn't look like quality in the picture don't buy it. Is it looks like something you can buy at the 99 Cent Store chances

I think the app is decent, but not always totally amazing. It is a little hard to find ways of getting general customer service from aliexpress from an actual person, if their FAQs don't adequately explain what to do in a situation, and the app itself doesn't do a great job of helping this. Also, I wish there was a way to do a strict search, in or out of the app, on actual text terms in listings. I think the app could facilitate a much better search experience when specific results are needed.

Shopping is filled with disappointment as you realize most items are not cheaper they just charge the difference in shipping like eBay. Also never believe their est shipping dates. It will change to 2 months out once it "ships". Talk about a slow boat from China must be a raft. Most likely my first and last experience with this site. 2 and a half months of shipping time is just crazy. Worth paying a little more on Amazon to have it in 1 to 3 days imo.

I love the hair it is cheap enough to keep ordering, your hair won't look Junkie if you get it long enough and just cut the ends you'll be fine the hair usually comes when it says it comes basically within 3 to 4 days except the last time it took almost two months for it to get to me I was so pissed so for that I took away a star. Anything else that you see for example pants dresses or even makeup things for your hair it will take forever it feels like you order off the Wish app took star away.

Ads often show a low price for a pictured product. But when viewed, the price is actually for some other unwanted product. The product is often at a higher price than was advertised in the picture. Ye old bait and switch. That said, I buy from AliEx often. Identical products can be found cheaper than Amazon if you can wait 3 to 6 weeks for delivery. I just wish they had more truthful ads where the price in the ad photo was honored.

I have used this app for over 10 year. Lately it has developed some annoying errors. On the games, it doesn't always go back to the page it is supposed to when you click their back arrow. The games freeze during play. Their search engine doesn't find items you're looking for. It displays random items that have nothing to do with the search terms entered.

Some sellers dont send what you order. If you order multiple items keep close track of them. I have ordered several items that I never received. When I realized it, it was too late to open a dispute. One order was paid for by pay pal. I still have time to dispute it but There was no documentation on AliExpress that I ever ordered it.

I've bought many items. Most are accurate and decent quality. I'm not fond of the app so I normally use the desktop version so I can see the full screen. Unfortunately, for the last few months, the desktop site reverts to the mobile site, making it impossible to see the items on right side of the screen. There is a selection menu on the left that doesn't go away. please fix this so I can shop again on my Samsung Fold 6.

It is a good app to find stuff at low cost, but only if you have the patience to wait for them. The quality is good very often. However, once I did not receive an item; they had combined all my orders and one of them was missing. When I started dispute they denied a refund as it showed that the products were delivered. I asked for reevaluation and the seller also agreed for refund. The process is long and tedious & I am still waiting for the refund.

I love the products on this app. I've ordered many things. But there's still items I ordered in December that I never received and I let them know but never heard back nor got a refund. Now it won't even let me ask for a refund. There's no option since I already requested one. Other than that I love this site. Shipping is a little lengthy but it is coming from overseas so its to be expected.

Lots of stuff cheaper than Amazon. Great products. Shipping isnt fast but worth the price. Warning.... becareful which "store" you shop from...some are dishonest and steal your money. Aliexpress continues to side with "stores" and fails to refund moneys spent. For the second time in 2 months i have lost money on purchases i never received. Terrible customer service.

Sellers are tricky!They said I need to buy extra shipping fee separately from the order of jeans already placed, if not the item might get lost or stolen? Well I didnt do it the 1st time and my item got delivered, but to another state! Got my money back but then I ordered 2 more Jean's and they told me the same thing. Well I did it, cuz ididnt want my items to get lost again, but then realized Ishouldnt be doing that, and cancelled and they just wouldn't cancel no matter how many times I tried

Aliexpress has a lot of things at very good prices. The problem is that many of its sellers are unreliable and don't ship items. I've had to complain about more than 10 items because they never arrived. But I realized something that regularly the things that have a high price regularly and for some reason they put them at a much cheaper sale price are the ones that are not shipped. At least you get your money back, even if it's a little, but it's annoying not receiving things.

At 1st I thought it was great, but it turns out there are numerous flaws. Unless you're choosing free shipping, the shipping prices are often outrageously high. Some sellers are fake/scammers posing as real stores. You normally can identify them based on the names, when they start, the overall store reviews (some not available) ect. I made an order on an item and immediately they confirmed. But I cancelled my order as I felt skeptic on the lack of communication. I was refunded but not in full.

The app is fine, so far no problems. But some sellers are missleading. I paid extra to have my product shipped faster, got an email that says it shipped out but wouldn't be here for a month, 3weeks after the date I paid to have it here by, but then spoke with the seller and they tell me it hasn't shipped at all. They are lier's so need to be advised you don't get what you pay for.

I use this app and buy pretty much weekly. I was going through my lists and deleting sold out items. I went to add something to a list and suddenly I can't "Your wishlist has reached its limit" pops up. I NEVER had an issue and you would think since I deleted so many old items I WOULD HAVE ROOM. I literally added something to my list yesterday just fine. Now I CAN'T!?

Ok app better then some other such apps. But this one needs improvement too. 1st. In freebies, products to bye with coins and 0.01$ items, the items for men are very scarce! Especially clothes and undergarments (including simple and novelty) and accessories, it is mostly for women. 2nd. In filters, there is no check box system, so you cannot check multiple types or options together accept the only way that you don't use filters. I expect improvement in this. I will give better rating after that.

Deceit ! . . On the main page when you search it'll show your product for $1.00 for example you click on it and it's now $4.00 its a bait and switch. Not to mention that the shipping is NOW MORE then the products. Why would I pay $60 for the item and $80 for shipping?. Sometimes if you chat with the seller they'll give you a much lower quote not always but sometimes so it's a lot of wasted effort mostly. I would buy more if the shipping wasn't robbery. for what I'm buying no way it costs that

I've already ordered 2 times from Ali and had no problems, even got my items early but the 3rd time I ordered said I couldn't order something went wrong that I can submit an order claim so I did just to get a message saying there's no order claims to review. I want to know what's going on why can't I order again? I have 7 items I want to get. If this can be fixed I will leave a better review. It's nothing to do with my bank. Thanks

I used to really like this app. I've ordered several items and I've been pretty happy with them so far. I appreciate the tracking system they have. It's easy to see where my orders are and when I should expect them. But for the last couple days, I haven't been able to open the app. I've updated the app and nothing's worked. It simply says 'server error. Press back or try again.' Anyone else have this problem?

The games are not any fun anymore. They have removed items that I can't use anymore. taking little time to really take a look before I just leave til tomorrow or the next time. Now it's just something to do. Mundane and boring shipping costs are going up. Not really worth the long wait. company's don't keep items or offer items anymore. No one else steps in too offer similar items. Not worth my time anymore.

For items it takes a very long time to arrive. And honestly there's a better cheaper app for most items that take half the time with shipping from the same area. Though there are some things on Aliexpress you can't find on other apps. But you have to either really want it or have extreme patience when it comes to the shipping time. I have yet to receive and items on time. They are either a week to two weeks later. And a lot of the items I order the original boxes are damaged during the ship

Shopping on here in recent years has been a pleasure. My items always arrive accurately and in a decent amount of time. I can't complain about the products or shipping. However, the app does experience tons of problems. 1. The coin system is stupid. I think the coins you collect should convert into actual funds to use, like on shein. 2. The loading system has been terrible. Nothing loads some days, so you can't view products or reviews. Fix these and it's a good app to shop!

Works great except when the product you are waiting for never arrives and the guarantee time runs out, the store gets your money and says they've sent it but there's still nothing. Customer support is not easy to find but I give up. It's not worth my time and there's plenty of other alternative marketplaces to use that are more reliable and have better support.

My least favorite shopping app. Its the most confusing. I still havent figured out why I should get coins. But every time It says I should collect them, I tap on collect, and the screen goes white. A tutorial would be nice. Please remember, not all of your patrons are from the electronic age. We who are older prefer things to be straightforward.

Don't know if prices are messed up due to a current "sale" but nothing seems to have free shipping anymore. Or items that say they have free shipping, once you click on the item, the shipping isn't free. And the shipping is usually almost $3-$5. Won't be shopping on here until it gets fixed. Don't understand why it's like this all of a sudden.

I really like it but I've had items that didn't come in and when I report them I've gotten no help or response back and instead the listing will disappear. So customer service is basically nonexistent. I've been waiting months for a "refund" on 2 items from the same seller and 1 still "in dispute" from another seller. Not to mention most things you can't search because of copy rights I guess so it's hard looking for some things.

Only downside is that sellers mark orders as "finished", meaning completely delivered, when it's not; when products are still in transit and have not been delivered to the buyer's final address; this becames an issue since the buyers have limited time to get a refund in case the product of an order never arrives. Also, products should be tracked individually, separately; to avoid some being marked as finished/delivered when other products in the same order number are still in transit.

had it for a while and decided to make my first purchase. the app is clearly for show. it does not allow to collect coupons or even buy my items. it keeps sending me to a computer. went there had to confirm email and go through a whole bunch of unneccessary steps. annoying and frustrating. considering deleting it if the update doesnt fix all these glitches.

I like the prices and I don't mind converting metric. Descriptions are not always clear on what or how much is included. Biggest problem is trying to figure out options when there is more than 1 choice. Pictures are way too small and can't be enlarged. I got a new device and my account didn't transfer. Can't find a way to contact customer support. I have gone through all steps available in app. Finally Uninstaller and then reinstalled.

The app. is a little sketchy/odd. For the America market you need better a interpreter for item descriptions... not easy to quickly grasp descriptions. Sizes of clothing are the worst. Almost intentionally vague, nondescript wording that tells the consumer nothing. Not all vendors but most have a habit of complicating a $3.00 purchase... Made my first order yesterday let's see how that goes.

App is ok. Easy to search especially, with the photo search. The reason I don't give 5 stars because recently, they downgraded my member level, 2 times without telling why. It'd be better if there is some explanation for that. Also, customer don't have right as much as seller. If you want to cancel, seller can refuse our cancellation even they're not even prepare yet. How rediculous!

It helps to know which vendors/shops are verified, to keep from wasting time and money on those with bad ratings. Also, I love that more vendors are including tracking that's more reliable and updated until the package is delivered. One thing that I didn't like at all was losing all the points I had accumulated after having upgraded my phone. I re-downloaded the app with my correct info (50,000 coins gone). As it continues to improve, I'll update my review of this app and the vendors I've used.

Be careful who you buy from. Make sure it's not a new shop and it has plenty of positive feedback and followers. That being said, even that may not save you. Many of the items in shops aren't actually in stock, despite what the listing tells you. Sellers would rather pretend to ship the item, make a shipping label, wait for the label to expire, and force you to cancel for an item that never arrives (the wait for this can be 65+ days) instead of being honest with their listings to begin with.

I'm able to find so much stuff that I really don't need at an incredibly affordable price. The draw back is waiting 3 months on shipping. The other major draw back is having my credit card info stolen... The pics used are for the most part stock pics, and sometimes aren't even of the actual product knock off, which makes buying from here risky

Only 3 stars because some sellers are ridiculously SLOW! ! I had several sellers wait over a month, never contacted me, I wrote them and they said sorry we don't have that item. We'll why don't you contact the customer so they can order it somewhere else?! That's so disrespectful! And other sellers take a month just to process the order... A WHOLE MONTH! When I sell items I send out the item right away to keep the customer happy! SMH But there is SOME GREAT SELLERS that are fast at processing.

Was ok with my first order but my second was a phone case and I got one for a totally different phone tried to contact the specific seller and still a week later no returned contact as I'm not sure how to take care of this or if I shouldn't even waste my time... I want to keep keep using the app as it has great deals but wrong products not much I want to figure out as I like things simple ...

The website referred me to the app for lower prices. Even though my price wasn't lowered, I continued my order through the app. My order was cancelled by AliExpress claiming suspicious activity. I lost my coupons and it took 2 weeks for a refund to post. I suggest you check the app to see if the prices are lower and if they aren't, order online.

I have been a customer for a couple of years. If there has been an issue, the sellers are eager to help. Only had a couple of times that I had to report the seller. The thing that really bothers me is the initial price, that us shown with the pic of the item, has a price listed. When you touch the pic to get more info, the prices are higher. They don't match the initial price. This is very annoying.

I've placed 2 orders so far. The first was great, the seller gave me a fair estimate of the time and the product works as well or better than advertised. The second seller did not communicate when my order would arrive, did not communicate where it was delivered to, and then refunded me so I couldn't leave a negative review.

I've been buying for years, sometimes it's a hit but sometimes a miss. The customer service is useless at times and I feel like they expect us as customers to go on wild goose chases to find the item. I just limit myself to the amount I'm willing to spend so I'm not too mad. I wish the sizing would be consistent also.

Not good app. Sellers have monopoly. The store itself is really to navigate, if you can get through the constant popup spamming. Pricing is pretty decent. confusing ways. For instance they show you 2 ethernet to usb adapters in the same picture. 1 is usba a, the other usb c. The app is too busy and distracting. It's hard to accomplish anything because 1 you can't find your messages or likes or anything, and 2 there are a lot of useless and annoying pop-ups! Prices are cheap, and it's pretty easy to find/get free shipping for most stuff. I also really like how you can play games to earn coupons or game points to exchange for coupons. Great. update: after using the app for a few months now, I noticed that it will generate an item you already bought. usually with more choices of the item you already bought and sometimes cheaper. the latest glitch (if we can call it that) has been from a lot of stores offering discounts. but again, only after you've purchased what your were looking for

still one of my favorite apps to shop online, I have been loyal to this company since day one. I wish they could have stuff like temu, don't get me wrong... I just want more options. I liked the app when I first used it in 2023 where I could add anything to cart and it all be really cheap. But now prices have been upped. this store has great deals and every time I get on the app I want to spend all my money because they have so many items I want and it need. the only problem I have with them is how long delivery takes, even know they tell you and do deliver in the time frame they give, I still don't like waiting on things I pay for for 2 weeks, that's just way too much time. it's not like anything I buy gets personalized.

The ordering went rather smooth. Most apps like these are good at reeling you in, so we'll see. I love this app. But there's a little glitch when looking at your cart. Sometimes it resets when you leave your cart to shop more, other times you can't remove items you don't want, and other times it won't let me click on a specific item in my cart to view it closer. Other than that, I love the app. Everything is cheaper on here, and I love the free shipping when spending $10, it's very attainable. Please keep this app great.

I love this app! It's so good and I love the products are decent priced. There is always an event going on that lets you get coupons. Also you can get coins from doing simple stuff. Promotional products are weird sometimes, but you can always hide them. Also, when you're on a stores page, it lags a lot. I hope Aliexpress can fix this!!

Very easy to use. Some tracking of shipments HAVE to be done on the app so I downloaded it. Not a bad experience, but if you look at one product you may be hounded with ads for it until you buy it. Notifications pop up quite a bit when the app is active (i.e. even if you "close" the app you will get ads. The only way to stop the notifications is to force stop the app). The app is also the only way to get some of the reduced prices and shipping and to accrue points to convert for discounts.

Lots of cool stuff, most of it quite reasonably priced, and some of it super cheap. Shipping is usually cheap, too. Sometimes the quality can be questionable, but the prices are so cheap it's hard to complain much about it. And sometimes the quality is surprisingly good! Shipping can take a while, but with the Covid situation, that's to be expected.

Overall, a good App. There are a few changes needed. For one, I dislike that they show an item for a price, once you click it you find that the price shown doesn't match the pic but was the lowest cost associated item with the product that was pictured not the item itself. This shouldn't be allowed as it is misleading and false advertisement. That's my biggest gripe. There is more of a converted effort on Ali's behalf to ensure a better shopping experience than in the past but there's still some

I order from Aliexpress quite often. If you don't mind waiting a month or more for your product to arrive. Most products are well worth the price. You do have to be very careful when you are reading the descriptions, colors, size, Etc. I've had a couple issues where I had to open the dispute but they were handled quickly and to my satisfaction. Many items ship free to the United States however there are several that do charge for shipping. Overall I would give the site an 8 out of 10.

Very trustworthy, deliver on time, and have stuff at a very low price. Only need to speed up the process of a refund, or make it a little more accurate. for example, if you give a wrong location just ask for the location no matter if you have to charge to move the item from a location to the current location needed. You dont always get what you want (sometimes they ship the wrong thing), sometimes you don't get your order at all. 95% of the time, I get my items. Sometimes they never show up but it's okay, the sellers usually cooperate in time. I love all the items I order and receive. I stock up on the cutest stationary I come across. I'd recommend this place even though it takes about a month or two to receive items. If you're patient, it's absolutely worth shopping here.

Various products with good prices. I have been as a customer since 2016. Recently, I have an issue with my order. A lot of stuff for cheap(er). You just have to be mindful, as with any other business like this. Read the fine print. Check all the available purchase options. Also always check the cost of shipping. Sometimes you see an awesome price, but then find that the shipping essentialy makes it normal price. Of course everything is coming from china (mostly). So be aware of shipping times. I live on the east coast and generally most items i purchase take 2 weeks. Sometimes longer, sometimes shorter.

UPDATE:: I gave 4stars since AliExpress will get you your refund when you open a dispute. Other than that the wait is the only other bad part having a long wait and it never comes. There are some honest sellers, some not so much and if u open a dispute, get your refund. Love the stuff on the app but more times than not, you do not receive the product you order after having to wait 2-3 months for it, it still never shows up. 4 out of 5 items I ordered never came so seems more like a gamble.

I shop on many competitor sites, and they all have their pros and cons. AliExpress is no different. Great deals, visually appealing coupons, large selection, and clear refund policy. On the flip side, difficult descriptions at times, some things never ship, deceptive pricing by some sellers, and can take extremely long depending on the seller and item. Overall, I've been sourcing overseas for 20+ years online. If you know what you're doing, it's the only way to shop.

It's a great app for buying small, novelty items like stationery and unofficial merchandise. I've purchased many K-Pop pins and keychains as well as anime stickers and figures. It's surprisingly low priced for the decent quality of items. I don't recommend purchasing items that you have expectations of high quality for. It's all mass produced in China and shipped to other countries. Shipping takes about a month, so gifts would need to be purchased far in advance. I recommend the app!

Each seller provides a description of their products, some are very accurate some are "less accurate." They would like reviews of the products you buy but if you buy more than one product you don't know what products you are to review, the product photo doesn't show up on the review area. Waiting 2 weeks to 3 months is normal to receive your order. Sometimes you never receive your order but they will give you a refund. Prices are usually better than Amazon if you don't mind the wait.

I very much enjoy the use of this app. I do not like the games and such or the come ons that come with it. However the prices are unbeatable and the coupons and various sales options they offer are pretty amazing! The shipping is pretty spot on for the most part.... however they have lost my package 📦 and refunded almost immediately after my request. So yes I lost my merchandise but didn't lose my money. I have been watching for a delayed package and have coupons due to the delivery delay.

The app is overall very amazing it can sometimes be a hit or miss kind of shopping app but I have enjoyed almost all of the products I have bought for the low prices that are offered. Shipping varies from seller to seller I have waited a month for an order but normally orders will come in a couple weeks once placing the order, and some orders can come in a few days.

Mobile app is easier to use than the desktop version, because the site opens a window for every product you view, which makes it difficult to navigate. As for the shop, I've purchased several items, and shipping can vary from early, on time and late. I've select products from seller's that have detailed product information as well as plenty of details about the company.

Honestly the biggest issues is the same with the "Wish" app, to many scam seller's. Gotta be a way to at least keep more out than is kept our right now, cuz there's quite a few, especially any with mystery boxes as product's. Like Custom Engravings!

A lot of inexpensive products and love just looking through products looking just to buy something I don't really need lol. The only sell off with them and every other type of online store is time of delivery. Just received two orders today from two different stores. They have a lot more of a selection then the other similar stores.

The app can be a little confusing at check out if you start to place your order and change your mind and back out. It places all the items in a "need to pay" tab instead of keeping them in your cart. But you can't get to the tab from your now empty cart, you have to go to your account menu. And the tracking isn't very explicit. You will need something like parcelsapp to find out where your items actually are. I also don't care for the way prices fluctuate rapidly and drastically.

This is actually a pretty good app although when I order stuff it takes a while but the prices are significantly lower that that of say Amazon, but they do have items that can be shipped within 7 days and thats a good thing but they also got bundles like selecting 3 items for $5.95 or $9.95. In the end use this app if u want to save and get that gift for the someone but get it early, like really early

It is a cool app with anything you can think of at good prices. Hard to understand how it all works without ordering something and seeing what is what. The menu on the bottom is key. ALI is just a middle man with many stores that are separate entities. So I ordered items for a project from different stores and will get them at different times. Just received first shipment. Items were well protected and delivered ahead of schedule. But keep in mind schedule is 27 to 45 days. So far not too bad.

It's the ideal place to shop for the genuinely budget bound man (or woman) whom knows exactly what they want. Cautious shopping is advised, at all parts of the purchasing and canvassing prospects, as a few sellers are deceptive in their practices. That being said, once you've learned to spot the few ways a merchant could try to get over on you, you will be able to expertly pick through millions of items, often at as low as 3% of their Amazon listed counterparts. Truly incredible values.

There are many reviews so that shoppers can get a better understanding of the products. However, there is no way to edit a review. I would leave a review and the seller would contact me then I would like to upgrade my review based on the interaction but there is no way to do so. Also the questions should be changed to focus on the specific item. Many sellers charge ridiculous amounts for shipping. These charges should be clearly stated when shopping and comparing items.

this is one of my fav apps to shop on but the navigation is confusing and the listing in a certain order is not very accurate. some products say shipped/delivered but they're not received. some never ship and sometimes I don't get a refund. tracking rules are terrible. and prices change too often. can never find the lowest price. some items are listed/featured differently than the actual item. always check quality and if damaged/broken as soon as you receive it and report issues asap. 90% good!

I'm a new user—lots of overseas stuff in China & Turkey. Buy from a store that has a name. No buying from stores with just numbers. Read the reviews if you're having doubts about a product. Cheap rates, but the shipping can take a while, sometimes 5 or 6 weeks. Usually, it's about 26 days. Message seller before hand to see what the actual product looks like.

I purchased a vast amount of products on this website many years ago and the saying always goes " you get what you pay for". All the products I recieved broke down over time, half weren't what they were advertised as and the shipping time frame of course. I decided to make multiple purchases recently after those many years and AliExpress has shown improvement in there products/services. I purchased about 50 cheap items in order. All came early! My order of 33 was missing an item. I only received 32. I was denied a refund for my missing item, so I submitted photos of the shipping label and of the items I received, and weeks later it was approved. My refund arrived nearly 2 months after my purchase. My items were shipped quickly and are good products. Came in great condition too. Still a bit miffed about the delayed refund but would recommend the app. Turned off notifications.

Just remember nothing is perfect. You might get a bad seller here and there. The more you use the app, the more you'll know what red flags to look out for (no different from E-Bay). I like to screenshot every transaction and communication with the seller. If you're buying overseas like I do, I use PayPal when checking out. This acts like a safety net, in case you need to get your money back. There's lots of sellers that offer quality goods, the same you'll find in retail stores if not more.

Aliexpress sell good 3rd party products. Even in video games that will come in handy on long trips. Wish they wouldnt take too long to shipped it but its worth the wait. And one last thing to buyers read the comments on ratings. Sometimes the seller will scam you for money or in details. Doesn't happen too often but better to be safe than sorry.

MOST sellers are great and easy to work with. It sucks to have to wait so long before opening a dispute though, especially if there's no tracking updates. I've had several orders not shipped out at all, but have received refunds for the vast majority of them. Overall it's fun and pretty quick with awesome prices. (Beware of clothes running RIDICULOUSLY small though)

Has many of the samethings Amazon has, but far lower priced. But not as easy to use. It takes many days and using to realize how to navigate the items to buy. They need to make this app more like the Amazon app. It's also confusing how they have different sections to buy the same items and they cost different prices. Way too many emails and push notifications for products, had to turn those off. Games to collect coins & ofiers are non stop. I don't think there's a way to trun those off. Kept up to date on entire shipping except for the actual delivery. There was a notification in the app, but didn't receive an email or push. Overall great experience so far. My items arrived ahead of schedule! Everything was in great condition and working. Was supposed to be March 4th - 8th, but arrived Feb 20th.

A great app for a great website. I only gave 4 stars due to the confusing way adverts are displayed, which is identical in the app and website. It's often not clear what version of a product you're looking at, as products ship with differently bundled accessories, or different specifications, and I see others leaving reviews where they've been caught out. I personally go elsewhere if not clear. At least on here, a search brings up relevant goods, Amazon could learn a thing or two about that.

I've had my challenges with AliExpress at times, but things seem to be improving. I REALLY wish they'd not auto confirm based on mail tracking, which can be incredibly unreliable in SE Asia. It almost caused me to lose money on products I never received. That said, if you don't use tracked shipping, it usually comes in at some point, and the selection of goods is very nice.

I really like the app, however, lately when you get ready to buy a product the shipping costs change sometimes. Another thing i don't like is the misleading prices that are posted. A product may have one price,, and when you click on it, the price may miraculously change to more expensive. I just don't buy from these sellers. So, be careful. I don't know if this site has product testers, but if it does, I would really hope to become a one. Especially for the sites, I frequent.

The app is great I love the prices and the variety of things is unbelievable!! The only thing is I really wish there was a way to have more control over my "cart" like when I add a bunch of things I can go to my cart and select only a few if thats all I want to pay for right then but once I hit the "pay now" button I've got no way to revise my cart if I realize that I forgot to add something. I think my cart should be available to revise up until the point of charging my payment method.

I ordered some items in mid-November BEFORE seeing all the bad reviews on here. I've previously only ordered on Wish so that's my point of comparison. While I am very disappointed in it taking over 2 months to receive my items (hence the 4 Stars), they arrived in good shape and were exactly what I'd ordered. I'm willing to give it another try. The biggest downside of the app is the notifications but they're not too bad.

There's so much stuff!! This is eBay's backyards sale type of place. You'll find items which you simply won't find easily anywhere else. The only thing i Mark it down for is somewhat confusing pricing scheme. Basically you get a voucher, when applying it to an item, suddenly the price goes up since there was already a markdown of the product that couldn't be combined. So you need to be a bit vigilant when checking out. I'm like a kid in a candy shop in this app.

I have brought items using this app and the app works well, very easy to find what you are looking for, they have a huge variety of items and prices are good, free shipping can be slow if you don't want to pay for shipping. But all in all the app is great, I enjoy using it. Update, I have recently notice that some sellers are showing an item with a low price but when you go to puchase it, it is not that item. It is a different item for the lower price. And the item you wanted cost more. Unfair.

Everything looks good, service is a little slow with some items, you can talk to the sellers and see if they read your responses, however I did have one that's continuing to be rude. But mostly I have a positive experience. I just received my first item. 3 left so far to come. Also I have discovered some even give coupons, which is a really nice touch as well!!

Just received my first purchase. It's not Amazon when it comes to shipping, but what can you expect from China!? Items are often very inexpensive, and you often get what you pay for (low quality). That said, if you pay attention and don't get duped by misleading pricing on many items, you can find some great buys on this app! Just be cautious when there are several options on a single product, with only one option being at the low advertised price.

Overall great and fun. I wish there was a way to automatically filter out items that can't ship to my address for whatever reason - it's annoying to find the perfect thing at the perfect price, only to be told "The product can't be shipped to your region", especially when another option in the listing can be shipped. I know most items have it listed somewhere, but it's easily missed. Please just filter them out rather than waste my time. Otherwise great.

I've ordered probably 50+ items from here and only once was there a minor problem that was resolved fast! I admit I was a bit leary to sent my credit card info, but in 3+ years, they've proven themselves to me! Just do searches to find the best price and highest feedback. Edited to add that customer service is NON-EXISTENT! Don't order anything that is too expensive for you to lose, because you are out of luck if THEY lose it.

While I don't always find what I'm looking for with the search tools, the other functionality and the customer support have been great! I have made a some new business relationships with reliable vendors. When I ran into issues with unreliable ones we were able to work through the dispute process. Tracking system does leave a little to be desired (if the vendor has to use multiple packages they have to manually send you the information so you can track it on your own). Overall a great tool.

My experience has been very positive. However, it has not been perfect. Whenever I want to view an order using the link in my emails, they try to get opened in the app, but never load. Other than that, it does the job of allowing me to quickly lookup for stuff, but I stick to the desktop experience for serious shopping instead.

It's a good app. There is room for improvement tho, like product listing it shows the price of item, I would like to see the shipping price also listed next to the cost. Alot of time is wasted clicking on item just to click back out because the shipping cost. or, the price is not for the pic shown. When you click on it it's actually a bigger price. So it does take some patience to navigate the real price of pictured items. But I think this app is better than Wish.

This is basically the Amazon of China, if I'm not mistaken. So far I've ordered a few items and have experienced no issues. Just be smart and stick to the sellers which are reputable. It's smooth sailing and you get a reasonable price for items which might otherwise be more expensive or extortionate elsewhere. If you can handle the longer shipping speeds which are understandable given various circumstances then you'll have no problem finding what you need and being happy with the end result.

My overall experience with AliExpress is a 4/5. You have to be careful with particular sellers and check ratings, pictures, etc: however, any issues have been taken care of by the Ali team in a rapid fashion. It is sad that the prices of many products have gone up within the last year. Some items I can already purchase in the states for the listed price. I would not wait a month to order and recieve my item. Long story short: if the price is right and the seller is reliable it's a WIN!

Interesting to see what is being sold (mostly from China). You need to be selective about choosing items and sellers because of varying quality and service standards. Also the items can take a long time to arrive, yet you could receive decent discounts on some items by removing all the middlemen and resellers in the US (which are sourcing many of their products from China, anyway).

Very good shopping app, my favorite to use. Cute items for cheap prices. Ships pretty quickly for the place it's coming from, my only problem is that the sizes are not inclusive. Most of the clothing sizes from small to large, they all have different sizing charts but 3 sizes is definitely not enough. if you want shoes and your size is over a US 9, it's very difficult. I have managed to find some, but it was hard.

I have used this platform for over a year now. I have not had any shipping or quality issues. Very pleased. My go to app when I need items for reasonable prices. My only two complaints are that when I want to order more than one option of the same item, I cannot do it.( i.e. different colors of same item) One must order each option separately. Also, understanding how the coupons work can be a little confusing at first.

Hard not to admire... or get a bit addicted to the deals that can be had. But, buyer beware, all kinds of trickery or forgeries abound. And, hard to decipher what you're ordering versus the images, descriptions, and headlines of the item tickling your fancy. I've gotten some truly awesome deals... and mind-blowing junk I wouldn't have paid one red cent for, not the 3 bucks I shelled out (and then waited three weeks to maximize the eventual disappointment). Take your time, explore, wait, enjoy!

Overall great! If you live in the US and you order from this site, order a size up. Most items are fantastic, but occasionally you get clothes that are not made properly. I ordered 12 items from one place and only 11 we're delivered. When I went back to the store that I purchased, that item was out of stock. I didn't receive a message or refund. I've also ordered from stores that were good at communicating.

Great place to shop. Been using it for years. I'm pretty I was probably an early adopter. Some hiccups have come along with the Plus and Choice options. I hope they're hiccups and not intentional. There have been times when I could but more times I couldn't edit my Picks or items in Choice. I couldn't even cancel. I had to wait a couple of days for it to automatically cancel before I could go back in order what I wanted. I think we this will likely get ironed out soon and I'll update this review

I've reviewed this shopping app before and gave it one star. At the time everything was going wrong. I was getting items that didn't last. They'd break under the lightest usage conditions and I could not get a resolution on a credit that was owed to me. I had to go through my bio and lo and behold I got not only the 50% credit they offered me I got a total refund back into my bank account. Since then I've still been shopping on this site and have bought a lot of items. I've had positive results.

The products are great. The reason I gave it a four star is because if you order several items at once, they may be shipped from different sellers and therefore you have to pay separate shipping fees for each seller. I don't like that bcuz it really adds up fast. This brush cost the same for shipping as it did for the actual product. So, I felt like (and I did) pay double for the product after shipping. Deceptive Practices with this Company: Beware of price increases in your cart. Bait & Switch from Day 1. Also, clicking on an item of interest from the main page will show a low price. Only for the buyer to find out that the seller has listed multiple items in the same lot-and the pictured item of interest is really 3X as much! Editing as I made a purchase and "somehow" I don't have changing prices in my cart anymore. However, I still see wrong prices listed on ads w/multiple items.

It's okay if you don't mind waiting 𝙪𝙥𝙩𝙤 a month or sometimes more for an item... Keep in mind this isn't true for 𝙖𝙡𝙡 items... The app is cumbersome. It is hard to know for sure what you are ordering by the titles and images, price changes with each picture. There is not a US size reference, so I had to Google search. The prices are reasonable. The shipping is about two weeks. I'm not sure why there are games on a shopping app, but ok. Overall, I am happy with my shopping on AliExpress.

Great app except that I do not like the "Bait and switch" tactic used to present many of the products. Oftentimes, the advertised price does not correspond with the product in the photo. Instead, the price often represents a component part of the item that's only revealed after opening and viewing the product. The sum of all the time spent opening these misrepresented items adds up.

Overall I really like the app. It has really cool stuff, tons of stuff at good to great pricing for a lot of it. My annoyance is the coupons & how you pay the 20 coins thinking it'll work with what you're buying, afterall it's with the store coupons, then come checkout your order is suddenly ineligible. As added insult coupon "purchases" are nonrefundable.

"Good experience overall. The products I ordered were as described, and delivery was faster than expected. I don't understand how I can place an order and only receive a portion of my order. only to find out the other portion was never processed?? and how is it that the shipping is more than the product itself?? Everything comes quick now. However, some of the things that I have ordered in the description. It's not what I get. For the most part great prices, speedy delivery, other than the misrepresented items, it's a great app. I also realize the items in question are the sellers fault not the app. A little more quality control on the app's part would be great making sure they describe their items legitimately.

The only things I don't like is when you save an item to your wish list and go back to your search results, you have to swipe forever to find where your were and then there should be page numbers so if you didn't save something you can go back to the page you remembered being on. Oh, one more thing, I am sourcing a lot of different categories and there is a limit on the number of categories you can make and a limit to total items saved. This is a huge negative, but it's not the app. The China sellers compete with you by selling on Amazon & EBay. I can't make a profit. Sellers should not be both wholesaler and retailer.

Addicting! I've been using the app for a while now, and I find loads of well-priced items for both fun gifts and useful items. Living in the US, I find it takes 2-3 months to get here, currently. Although I've made sure to buy from sellers with a 95%+ rating, there have been times items don't get sent, and the return process can be slightly annoying when you're just looking for a refund. Overall, I ❤️ the app and have even won freebies 2xs! Unfortunately, I think Ali is getting rid of that tho..

Overall satisfied with my purchase.. Needs some improvements, but not a bad online company to do business with ! UPDATE: Pretty much, the only complaint I could come up with, is the shipping time🤷 It does take quiet a bit of time to receive your purchase. By the time you DO actually receive your purchase, most of the excitement has disappeared 🤦🤷 Soooo, if AliExpress could find a way to ship items faster, that would be AWESOME😁✌️

I'm rather surprised how often I get items in good quality considering the price. When you dig into the ecosystem of the app like the daily coins, it's very easy to save money! Just beware not everything you get will be to expectation -- so don't go buying home electronics or something like that. I've had the most success with toys, trinkets to help with organizing, and bedding.

Most everything I've ordered has been as described. Watch the cm and kg as in the US, we use inches and pounds. If you take the time to read the description and specifications you'll be happy with your purchases. I don't purchase clothing because they carry small sizes. So far, the sizing charts run very small, so I don't bother trying to purchase clothing.

Overall The app is pretty good. I do have some issues though. #1: Please don't give me a massive popup every time I open the app. It's so off putting and it makes me feel like I'm on some dodgy website. #2: When Reviewing a product and trying to upload a picture, the app only accesses the camera folder and in that folder only has access to the photos that were taken on the device you are trying to use. So if I take a picture on another phone or camera and sync them those photos will not show up.

It's a bit confusing getting through all the deals, coins, games & offers when I just want to purchase a single item. I'm a new customer & the prices are competitive(in this case much less than competitors), so I took a chance with this company. I will continue to work through the app to make my experience less distracting.

AliExpress needs to allow reviews past the 30 day mark, if not using their "Choice" faster shipping it usually takes over 30 days to receive the item. I have bought some figures that the quality was subpar at best. I wanted to leave a review to warn other people what to expect with my own pictures (some derpy looking eyes and such), but I couldn't due to it being past 30 days. Reviews are there to warn other buyers about quality. Do better AliExpress.

Definitely a big difference from the first time i ever ordered! I tried again and this time it was the seller who was the issue! Recently an order was missing a key part and I received a full refund within minutes! The price changing when you pick something makes sense the more you shop. I like the opportunity for credits. I just wish I could use my coins! I don't understand how! Also I need help fixing my phone number and nobody can figure it out! Otherwise I love the products I've received!

I enjoy the variety of items available on AliExpress especially the men's clothing. The styles differ from the US which is great. You just have to be cautious considering Asian sizes run much smaller than US sizes. I wish the men's shoes would go up to a size 12 rather than just a size 9/10. Prices vary. I am cautious when ordering more expensive items because returns can be pricey and time consuming.

Good products that are available elsewhere but much cheaper here. Just allow plenty of time for delivery. (anywhere between 1 and 2 months) Some sellers ship from the USA very quickly only with higher shipping charges. There are some who ship for free from the USA. Excellent buying experience except for communication with sellers. It is obvious that many of them understand very little english if you need to ask a question.

Everyone that is complaining about this company is complaining about the app. It doesn't lag, it has a like button, you can put things in a wish list, you can contact sellers "if they are legit". My issue and why I gave a 1 star, I ordered 13 items over 2 weeks ago, all items say they have been delivered, but I've only received 2 items.

I like the app, its very easy to use. There are organizers which is good. The only reason i didn't give it 5 stars is bc some items in the app is advertised wrongly. I thought i could get this item that was the photo i clicked on for a low price, but when i go in, it turns out its a different item on the list that is that low price not the one in the photo. Other than the slow shipping as well and too many notifs, everything is good, i really enjoy the app ^^

I will say it has Improved in 3 months. From a 1-4 and I have a few suggestions for to help Beginners. Ali Express is many store in one. It has everything you can think of in all the many Stores. That was the only thing I had a problem with was I thought it was 1 Store but it AliExpress and they have it all. The negative things I wish were there. Is an Invoice to know who to contract and get details handle easier.

It's great. You can find really good stuff for great prices. The only downside is it takes 3-4 weeks to get your order if you just use standard shipping. They do have faster shipping times if you're willing to pay the price. I love this app. I order all the time here because of the prices & I'm willing to wait a month to get my package. Don't expect fancy packages though. That's how they save you money is with generic packaging. But I who cares what the packaging looks like? Not me!👍👍

Alli Express sells quality stuff you can't buy on Amazon. I buy lots of high end fidgets through. lots of payment options. you can be as cheap as you want or buy expensive high quality items. Alli Express is great, the only problem is that sellers sometimes don't follow rules. I did a partial refund and a seller retaliated and black listed me, against the rules of Alli Express, but Alli Express gave me a full refund with needing to return the item afterwards. Awesome.

I've used AliExpress for probably 10 years now and it's always been a great place to buy things. I especially like that you can combine multiple items to get free shipping. Shipping times have also gotten much faster compared to years ago, which could be several months. now you get your items in 2 weeks or less. Usually good sales too and there are always coupons to save you a couple dollars here and there. The app can be a little buggy sometimes with the add to cart button not working.

I have made a few orders on here and two of my orders were missing things. But as for the other 20 orders made they came in without a hitch. Though one of my other orders the items I received were so much smaller then I was expecting I do recommend this app. Just check out the reviews on the item or items you're interested in before you purchase.

Buy clothes at your own risk! A lot of the clothes are not good quality, cheap fabric, thin, the color is off, ect. Unless you are very skinny you will have a hard time finding clothes that fit and even if the measurements would fit you what arrives might not. I've had pretty good luck with jewelry and other things that arnt sized. The app itself functions well and is user friendly. If there was an error in shipping it will take some time to get sorted out but you will get your money back.

So far two deliveries have cone and look good. Two venderstracking info does not seem to be linked with Alliexpress and updated through the system. I wish Alliexpress would require better tracking to merchandisers using it.

Responsive, seamless, interactive & user-friendly. Still room for improvement. More categories could be added to sort search results. It would be great if you relaxed the limit to the number of wishlists that could be created; please allow up to 30 for starters. Thumbs up to the developing team.

App works great. Don't like all the crazy flash sales, deals, and oupons though. Makes the app hard to understand. So many stores selling all kinds of items; you have to read the description carefully before buying. Shipping can take longer than normal, but I've received everything I ordered within their estimated delivery time (sometimes two months!) Only one dispute so far because item was damaged an was given a refund.

Haven't ordered from Ali Express in years, but today, I ordered 1 item for less than a dollar, went to checkout and completed my order, free shipping! No game-ified spinning wheels for offers, no popups for special "free" gifts that turn out to be more of a bait and switch, no "you're almost ready" teasing to get you to order a minimum amount to get the free shipping. Just simply let me place my order and pay $1.08 for the 1 item I needed! Thank You for not being like Temu!

Not always easy to navigate. Account buttons are not available once you start browsing items. When you've done a search or buy something, their algorithm hyper-fixates on the same types of items over and over again forever. Yes, I bought a smart watch from AliExpress. It doesn't mean I want to keep buying smartwatches. Show me other stuff.

my experience on aliexpress I'm going to rate 4 stars because I have only had a few transactions where I didn't receive my items and when I contacted the seller they would keep saying wait another 20 days even after I'd already waited over 2 months. most sellers would refund money or reissue product. mostly the items are as described, so definitely read the entire description sizes especially. I love aliexpress I'm always ordering from there products are cheaper for most things.

Love Ali and all the stuff they offer, a lot of items you can't find anywhere else and if you do costs way more than on here! One of the coin games has a bad glitch and some of the shops items are deceiving, but I've come to learn that's the way it is with most of these types of shopping apps. Overall it's a great app!

millions of vendors here CAN and WILL scam you, & the search function can be really annoying giving you completely unrelated or already viewed/liked items over and over. HOWEVER the first problem can be fixed by using alihelper (theres an app and a chrome extension) and i havent gotten scammed since. the second problem, well i hope it gets resolved soon. people also complain about products taking 20-30 days to arrive, but this isn't amazon people 😂 the prices are low for a reason. overall fine

App works fine. But have ordered 5-6 items. Two I didnt receive. One said delivered, to anoter State, then seller cancelled the order.
