I'm actually pleasantly surprised with many of the things I've ordered from here. I know it's known for having cheaper, not so good products, but you can actually find some very nice things! I always check the reviews, especially ones with photos. I stay away from buying things like anime figures, they tend to be knock-offs, and clothes which are usually too small and made from cheap material.

The app generally works good. It is pretty cluttered with lots of postings of things for sale. Sometimes you get stuck in a particular store category and it's tough to get back to the home page so you can check out your purchases. Using PayPal is easy, and there is excellent shipment tracking information provided. Sometimes the pricing is really great! You do have to watch the shipping charges on larger items. They can get astronomical!

I have always been a cheap person and shied away from popular brands because I could never afford that kind of stuff. Alliexpress has great deals on the app along with affordable prices! My only critique is shipping takes about 2 weeks, but if you live in the U.S that should be expected. Otherwise it's phenomenal and I'm obsessed with this app!

A fun app with new products from around the globe. I had minor issues with shipping but realized I hadn't spoke to them about the lagging shipments. Very helpful staff both from the site and the stores. They saw a trend in what I was looking for and presented great products I hadn't thought or heard of, and also offered payment options. Good people working hard to find your product even if you don't know what it is yet!! Always fun to shop here!!

Generally very easy to use, however, after selecting an item to read details, icons for selecting between different purchase options are too tiny to be useful and can't be magnified. For options without useful text descriptions (which is almost always the case), this makes it impossible to select between the options. Would also be nice to sort by price + shipping.

I love the wide range of products at such a cheap price. BUT some issues. 1 the COUPONS. You have them secured and then when you go to order POOF! they're gone or not applicable or something. 2. The shipping is all separate which isn't that big of a deal but still annoying. Overall it's still really good though.

So far, I've had no bad experience with Ali Express... in fact, I kinda love this app very much! Checking out can be kind of confusing, though. I end up with a cart load every time. **Don't forget to use store coupons when available!**

Good prices,orders came in fairly quickly- can be a bit hard to find some items,the search could work better. ....still using app, the search engine could still be better. I like the app but my big complaint is every time you leave feedback or delete a completed purchase you are sent back to the top of your list and have to scroll all the way back down. It's no biggie if you have only a couple of orders, but VERY time consuming and annoying when you have quite a few. I bet it detracts people from leaving feedback. .

I haven't ordered a lot from the site, but most of my experience with ordering from them has been positive. I've only had one product so far that didn't work. And i'm trying to find a package that was supposedly delivered, but i never saw it. Thats out of about 8 ifems that i have ordered. Except the one missing item, every item has arrived earlier than predicted. Thats always a plus in my opinion. It's way better than that other app that's very similar to this one.

I haven't had any issues with them, except one out of the products I've ordered, and I got scammed on 1 of the products that was supposed to be a dual screen touchscreen laptop and it was a rubber keyboard cover that they charged me $36 for and I'm in the middle of a dispute, so depending on the outcome of that will decide on if I still use this app.

As a developer I like the app, as a consumer it could use some UX/UI improvement with the "my picks" and cart seperation. It's very confusing at first where the picks are (since not in cart). I got the hang of it now, but it really needs work. My family member downloaded the app and was fruatrated with that same thing and deleted it lol.

I have this app for several years and have bought quite a bit of merchandise. Approximately 98% of the items have gotten here quickly and are exactly as described. I have only had 2 or 3 items not delivered, but within a few days, I received a full refund on each. I had 1 item take a long time to get here, but the seller kept in contact with me, reduced the price of the item, and gave me a coupon toward my next purchase. I highly recommend AliExpress.

Updating my review. Overall happy with the items I have purchased. I have gotten great prices....what I am NOT a fan of is how they list the prices. Kinda deceiving noting the lower price in the group of products, and you select the picture and it's completely a much higher price..... And you can't use it to make a purchase in full.

Lots of cute items that I want. They have fast shipping! I'm glad to see that AliExpress has inclusive sizes. I hope they'll be more fashion clothes for plus size. I see many things that appeal to my liking. AliExpress has the cutest fashion sense. So that frustrated me.

The service alibaba is great, the app has its minor problems. The search feature isn't the best,. Its basically Amazon for asia. Its been around longer and is a bigger company. Ive been using it for years and love it. Only had one package not show up and it was for an item that cost 1.99 and I was immediately refunded. Same items you'd buy from Amazon but for literally 5 or 6times less. Read the descriptions it will tell you size materials, sometimes the pictures are deceiving.

I love the selection and variety they have to choose from. Unfortunately, sometimes they don't always sale what they show you meaning, you may not always get what you intend. Sometimes the thing in the picture may come as "the picture " itself! Lbs clean it up and you got a perfect 5 star rating from me!

Mostly a pretty good app. The coins page doesn't work at the moment though. Ordered products arrived surprisingly quick considering they come from China (2 weeks or so). The only hang up has been the final mile delivery service (who TF is "SpeedX"?) who has ZERO customer service and can't seem to find an address that every other service can find. Products did arrive, however, and are mostly as described. Do NOT buy memory (SD cards, hard drives, etc.) from these sites.

I love aliexpress and been shopping in it for years. You feel like Christmas when every thing you can think of is there on sale. The items are of quality and the sellers courteous, and in disputes aliexpress has always got me my money back which gave me confidence to shop more. Lately the shipping time has much improved, however the price of items has become less competitive and the shipping cost crippling (300 dollars on a 29 dollars item for example). Thank you, and keep making things better.

For the most part I like the app but not the shipping, more than a couple times now my stuff has been delayed or just flat out never came because my address wasn't put on the packaging and uses had to track me down to find where I'm at. That is very annoying, and because of that I will never spend more than a few dollars at a time on this app cause I don't know weather I'll actually get my stuff or not

The items I have gotten so far have been very cheap with free shipping and handling. I don't expect amazing quality on items I pay less than 5 dollars for. I have gotten maybe 3 items that I was not satisfied with for the price. Clothes seem to run a bit small but cute enough. And if it sounds like too good of a deal then it probably is. I have recently ordered a few items that are above $5 they should be here in a week or two.

Out of all the stuff we have bought from different stores around here... (Nearly 60 orders so far) we have only had one really rude seller.. that actually called me a few names, other rhen that... Great app. Just read the reviews before you purchase the items. That's more important.

The items are nice. The Shipping just takes a while. Plus the games that you play on the app don't work right. One game has no sound. The game with the logs don't give you the logs when you are close to finishing it . I have had to logs to finish for a while now. I decided to try this app again and I will delete it. I have been waiting and waiting on a order and it still hasn't came in. I guess I am getting a Refund, not sure. Plus I don't like the not knowing where my order is at .

I love this shopping site. Only downsides are the Chinese sizes running small, so can be a bit of hassle when trying to choose or determine for your usa sizes. The shipping can take a whole month of course, which I'm not a big fan of, but times flies by so quickly nowadays, so even much of a big deal anymore. Also, if the seller's sizing charts are written wrong, you sometimes end up with shoes that are too big, so other than those downsides, I love Ali better than I do that Wish site.

Good but confusing. there are so many different roads and neighborhoods and avenues and ways to buy things that it's easy to get lost, it's also easy to lose track of stores, and can be difficult to figure out which of 50 identical items is the one you should buy because they aren't identical. I understand that third party marketplace platforms are always going to have this issue but I feel like AliExpress could focus on features that help the consumer in this.

My last items I received very fast but it's not always the case. I've ordered in the past and didn't get items or refund or items with no instructions and broke and nonworking items even empty packages even had to wait a month for items but I recently ordered things and I give them a 9 out of a 10. Great items fast deliveries and good communication. So give them a try

You have to read the description of the product as well as reviews otherwise you might be disappointed. I have been happy with everything I have purchased with the exception of some denim print leggings. I didn't read the description and thought they were jeggings. Other then that everything else has been on point for what you pay.

Great site for ordering cheaply from China. I'm leaving 1 star because I was lured in with 3 or 4 offers of coupons and promos, but when it came time to pay, the interface suddenly bugged out and I couldn't scroll down, and as it turned out, the bottom of that screen was where I needed to go to put in the promo codes. I thought I would be able to put in the code on the next page, but I couldn't, so I got stuck paying full price, even though the discount was the whole reason I tried the app.

Have only used this app twice but have been very well satisfied. I order lots of craft items and some take several weeks to receive. Recently ordered a clothing item and received it in less than 2 weeks. All items have been received in good condition. Most items are free shipping but clearly stated on items that are not. Thus far I have been very happy. ONLY ISSUE IS THAT I HAVE TO LEAVE FEEDBACK ON EACH ITEM instead of one time for total order from the seller.

This is a great app if your looking to buy collectible figures and statues you won't be able to find anywhere else. I use it for mostly anime statues. I have had several bad experiences with not receiving orders but they will eventually refund all of the orders that go wrong. It just takes them 2 months in some cases for some reason and you have to stay on the customer service people. But overall it's been a great app for what I am looking for and can't find anywhere else.

UPDATE: The exchange I needed was taken care of in a phenomenal amount of time! So far so good with this shopping app! I will definitely be shopping more! 💜💜 I'm really happy with this app so far. The customer service interaction I have had has been nothing but great in all aspects. The shipping did take a bit longer than expected but overseas shipping can be tricky and tedious and I understand that. My item arrived, albeit smaller than expected but beautifully made and put together! This was my 1st purchase with Ali and I am looking forward to more shopping. 😁 I am currently working with my seller to see what can be done about my order but to be honest, I may keep the original seeing that it fit my teenager. Either way is a win for me!

Shipping is not bad at all, beings most products are coming from outside my country. I usually receive what ever I purchase in a week to a week and a half for all items I've ordered. And the one time I did have an issue they resolved it in a timely manner and I was very satisfied with their solution to the issue as well. I recommend this app. Their prices are honestly about unbeatable compared to eBay and Amazon IMO and they seem just as honest and eager to please.

Most of the items I have order arrived some sooner then I expect and others took like to 3 months. I have had problems with the items but Aliexprees disputes are very good in favor of me with the proof I send to request my money back. Some products are really good for the prices and some were not. But I love shopping here.

Overall I am very happy. The items I order don't take any longer than other discount apps, but the prices are lower than many others. Things I would like to see improved is the search engine. I find that things I search for are there but don't show up with normal key words. The other complaint is keeping track of orders. I don't get to rate items because they dissapear right after they feel they have been delivered. I worry about what would happen if I don't get an item.

Aliexpress is ok but there's lots of frustrations and disappointments you have to get ready to face, for eg, no telephone number to call someone directly, be careful how you choose the sizes of anything, cloth, shoes, coats, etc. I ordered a lady prayer garment, many months ago to now l have not receive it. I am not sure if they have taken the money off my account or not, and so many other things. If you're lucky some of your orders will come looking very beautiful and on time It's like try

I love this app and its cheap, yet adorable items! My only big gripe is that I can't scroll too long without getting male enhancement/adult toy ads. It's hit and miss with items, have to search around as some people have the same item for way different prices so have to search and find the best price. Also pay attention to pictures that show measurements so you know the item you ordered is the size you think it is (especially with toys). Otherwise the app itself is fine and the selection and prices are great!

I like the app but I have bought products from Ali only to have the page and store disappear when I tried to reorder more products. The stores page is completely gone. It's still a good place to order certain things but the prices fluctuate on a daily basis where a $30 item bought today will cost you as much as $38 the next day when you go to reorder from the same store. These huge price fluctuations need to stop.

Most of the stuff on here is good but also alot of it is knock off or will show up beat up. So be careful when shopping. But still good app because there are good items that are super cheap. Just have to look hard and be careful and make a few bad buys until you get it right. Better than spending say 200 dollars for an anime figure when Ali has a knockoff that looks identical for 40 bucks. Just have to wait longer for shipping too.

Before you use this app find a product you want on Amazon within the $5-20 dollar range and search it on here. Chances are it will be here at 50% of the cost of less it varies. I bought tools, and house cleaning products, on here for a fraction of the cost. The only 2 downsides of the app is your order will arrive with 1-1½ weeks later, and the app bugs out very often. When you click on something, it will be loading forever until you close and reopen the app. Very annoying, hence the 4 star

The website on desktop is 100% easier but the app is good for what it is. I get "the system is busy" messages often when i'm attempting to just navigate through the app. notifications can be a bit bombarding too. Other than that, i don't have problems with any sellers or products on the app. You definitely get what you pay for on occasion, (low price for a low quality) but I overall enjoy Aliexpress. Wish you could buy more that 40 things from one store too.

the follow-up is good I just didn't realize they were going to come from 20 different places. Although I get an email on the mail I just take so long you hardly remember what you ordered. I'm sure they will all roll in but it's hard. Waiting for them. So far so good, but its the amount of negative reviews for different items mostly electronics that keeps me from giving a 5 star rating. Lots of customers write about how the advertising is a lie with items such as phones and laptops that are especially ordered and when it arrives its merely a protector case or it never arrives.
